name: Speicherstadt and Kontorhaus District with Chilehaus
description: In the heart of Hamburg's port, Speicherstadt is a maze of red-brick warehouses with steep gables and small turrets, rising straight from narrow canals on oak-pile foundations. Built between 1885 and 1927 to store goods such as coffee, tea and carpets, it is among the world's largest warehouse complexes. Next door, the Kontorhaus district's grand office blocks include the ship-like Chilehaus.
